$comment-required: Object-level required array (ALL four fields required). Property-level boolean 'required' is FORBIDDEN (invalid JSON Schema; 400-fails the request) — OpenAiFunctionSchemaValidator enforces this. spaarkeai-compose-r8 task 052 RETIRED target_text and match_mode from this Action: text matching is no longer a placement channel for an AI edit (ADR-049 I-7), so the model is no longer asked for either. target_para_id is the targeting field. It stays NULLABLE via the type union ["string","null"] — required as a KEY (Structured Outputs demands it) but legitimately null when the caller supplied no anchor, in which case the edit is REFUSED rather than text-searched.

target_para_id.description: The document's own stable Word paragraph identifier (w14:paraId) for the clause this edit targets — copied VERBATIM from the targetParaId input when one was supplied, otherwise null. This is the ONLY placement channel (spaarkeai-compose-r8 task 052, ADR-049 I-7): the editor resolves the paragraph by this identifier and NEVER searches the document text for the edit's wording. A null identifier means the edit cannot be placed and is refused — there is no prose fallback. Never invent, alter, abbreviate, or reformat this value.

new_text.description: The proposed replacement clause language — self-contained, drafting-ready contract prose (no placeholders, no commentary, no markup). The FULL revised text of the paragraph target_para_id names; the editor diffs it against that paragraph's current text and marks only what changed, inserted as a pending track-change.

rationale.description: Concise plain-language explanation of WHY this alternative is better (≤1 short paragraph, ≤1500 chars) — names the concrete improvement, not a generic justification.

sources.description: Grounding for the proposal. Empty array when the retrieval layer supplied no grounding — never fabricated.

id.description: The retrieval-layer identifier for the source — never fabricated.

snippet.description: A SHORT supporting excerpt from the source.
